title: Newmark Advises on Sale and Financing of Offices at Riverpark in Redmond, Washington
summary: Newmark announces that the company assisted KBS, one of the largest owners of commercial real estate in the nation, with the successful sale of Offices at Riverpark, a 107,029-square-foot Class A office and medical office building
